objective: Construct and measure reusable background-independent temperature coefficient evaluation with source-backed species extension.
scope: default-direct exact duplicate-bundle removal in AxbiProvider point
prepared scalar and shared-grid batch evaluation
elemental ground-state carbon CI/RR/DR provider and opt-in table backend with per-channel domains
preserve: existing external running binary and checkpoints
direct provider APIs and their domain guards

conventions.units: retain per-channel source units; explicit conversion at consumer boundary

acceptance.positive_normal_scope: relative error applies where direct reference is finite, positive, and normal; exact zero/sign/branch semantics tested separately
acceptance.log_slope_metric: abs(s_table-s_reference)/max(1,abs(s_reference)) in smooth cell interiors if derivative API is implemented
acceptance.jacobian_consistency: no derivative API and no new Newton/Jacobian integration in this unit; future derivative must differentiate selected evaluator; direct analytic Jacobian with table residual is only approximate
acceptance.domain: reject invalid provider inputs; use direct provider outside table range within provider range; no clamping/extrapolation
acceptance.boundary: direct fallback for branch-crossing, zero-transition, subnormal, sign-changing, or uncertified cells
acceptance.numerical_admission: independent off-grid, boundary-neighbor, and scalar/batch comparisons; sampled accuracy distinguished from proved curvature bound
acceptance.performance_admission: report direct/prepared/table/batch timings including construction cost and repeated-query break-even; no universal acceleration claim
acceptance.trajectory_admission: requires separate matched trajectory evidence; this unit admits coefficient and point-RHS scope only

execution.authorization: parent commissioned bounded local builds/tests/probes; no external native campaign
execution.stop_rule: stop at root cumulative limit or concrete acceptance failure; return diagnosis before changing tolerance/model/closure

provider_selection: Voronov CI and Badnell ground-state RR/DR elemental carbon selected, exact rows/primary source acceptance pending; per-channel domains preserved and complete chain limited to their intersection; isotope-native 12C/13C unresolved
